bio.text: Curtis Gibson is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 18th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to the Ballotpedia survey, Gibson served as a Lake Wales City Commissioner from 2017 to 2021.

Gibson graduated from Lake Wales High School, earned an associate degree from Bryant & Stratton College in 2017 and a bachelor's degree from Kaiser University in 2021, and works as a property manager.
Gibson says Polk County is home and lists earlier jobs as a school board janitor, a mail carrier for the U.S. Post Office and an Amazon Air employee.
